entries.name: supads-setup
entries.description: Use when setting up the media generation keys (the managed key or your own vendor keys), checking which generation capabilities are ready or blocked, asking what the marketing server sends as telemetry or turning it off, or setting up a brand for the first time from its website so later work reads its profile and competitors. Not for analyzing a brand without saving a profile.

entries.name: supads-research
entries.description: Use when analyzing a brand from its website (colours, fonts, voice, audience, claims), turning a product URL or photo into facts for generation, finding who a brand competes with, researching the ads competitors run or have stopped, or auditing the ads your own account runs. Facts and reports only: nothing is generated. Not for deciding which ads to make next.

entries.name: supads-planning
entries.description: Use when deciding which ads to make or test next as concepts a producer can build from, or writing the words and plans of an ad: ad copy for a platform's fields (headline, primary text, description, call to action), what is said in a video (spoken lines or voiceover sized to the clip), the motion prompt of a video clip, or storyboard sheets for a video. Not for generating the finished image or video.

entries.name: supads-images
entries.description: Use when generating or editing an image from a brief or references, making an image ad, product photos (packshots, lifestyle or creative shots from a product photo), a reusable AI actor, influencer or model as one image, or resizing an existing image ad into the other shapes it has to run in. Not for a video, and not for ad copy that goes in the platform's text fields.

entries.name: supads-videos
entries.description: Use when generating a video clip from a brief, image or reference, a product ad video or commercial, a UGC video (a creator or customer on camera: review, unboxing, try-on, talking head), a cartoon or animated video for a product, a clone of an existing video ad with your own product, or spoken audio (voiceover, narration, text to speech). Not for an animation written as code in an HTML file.

entries.name: supads-coded-animation
entries.description: Use when looking for prompts people used to make videos as coded animations (motion graphics, explainers, 3D scenes, games written in HTML, Canvas, SVG, Three.js, GSAP or shaders), or making such a video yourself: an animation written as code in one HTML file, built from a reference prompt and recorded when a video file is wanted. Not for footage generated by a video model.
